不公平法官的内部：法学硕士法官偏见的机械解释Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias

Zixiang Xu AMAP, Alibaba Group Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence University of Southern California Sixian Li University of Michigan, Ann Arbor Huaxing Liu AMAP, Alibaba Group Xiang Wang AMAP, Alibaba Group Shuai Li AMAP, Alibaba Group Zirui Song AMAP, Alibaba Group Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence Xiuying Chen Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
摘要Abstract

现有的关于法学硕士作为法官评分偏差的研究主要在输入输出层面进行：它们扰乱输入，测量分数增量，并提出即时级别的缓解措施。我们认为，同样的偏见承认法官隐藏状态中的表征水平帐户，与输入输出视图相补充，并且在操作上有用，但它无法提供。我们报告了针对七名法官、七种偏见类型和九个基准的三项调查结果。Existing studies of LLM-as-judge scoring bias work predominantly at the input-output level: they perturb inputs, measure score deltas, and propose prompt-level mitigations. We argue that the same biases admit a representation-level account in the judge’s hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways it does not afford. We report three findings, across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks.几何Geometry：基线判断输入占据一个紧密的激活流形，而有偏差的输入沿着低维、特定类型的子空间移位，该子空间随着深度而锐化，并由三个估计器系列一致地恢复。: baseline judging inputs occupy a tight activation manifold while biased inputs are displaced along a low-dimensional, type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth and is recovered consistently by three families of estimators.因果控制Causal control：沿该子空间引导隐藏状态会在两个方向上驱动评分，正向移位会在干净输入上再现有偏差的评分，反向移位会恢复有偏差输入上的基线评分，而匹配范数随机方向会产生较小数量级的移位。: steering hidden states along this subspace drives scoring in both directions, forward shifts reproducing biased scoring on clean inputs and reverse shifts restoring baseline scoring on biased ones, while matched-norm random directions produce shifts an order of magnitude smaller.运营中Operational：对相同偏差方向特征的简单线性投影可以预测在三个完全看不见的基准上的判断失败，大大优于基于文本的替代方案。将偏差解读为激活几何，而不是输入输出噪声，将几何结构、因果控制和操作预测统一在一个框架内。该项目页面位于: a simple linear projection onto the same bias-direction features anticipates judge failures on three entirely unseen benchmarks, substantially outperforming text-based alternatives. Reading bias as activation geometry, rather than as input-output noise, unifies geometric structure, causal control, and operational prediction within a single framework. The project page is available athttps://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型现在通常被部署为自动法官：它们对答案进行评分，比较候选者，并为对齐和偏好学习提供奖励信号Large language models are now routinely deployed as automatic judges: they rate answers, compare candidates, and supply reward signals for alignment and preference learning[Zheng et al., 2023, Liu et al., 2023, Gu et al., 2024, Li et al., 2024a]。这种便利是有代价的。越来越多的工作记录了法学硕士评委根据与答案质量无关的表面线索来改变他们的分数，包括声明的作者身份、冗长、声明的同行共识、情绪基调和元认知主张. This convenience comes at a cost. A growing body of work documents that LLM judges shift their scores in response to surface cues that have nothing to do with answer quality, including stated authorship, verbosity, declared peer consensus, emotional tone, and metacognitive claims[Wang et al., 2024a, Saito et al., 2023, Panickssery et al., 2024a, Li et al., 2024c, Koo et al., 2024]。这种评分偏差会破坏基准的有效性，而且由于法官坐在 RLHF 和评估流程中，这些偏差会悄悄传播到他们要审核的模型中。. Such scoring biases undermine benchmark validity and, because judges sit inside RLHF and evaluation pipelines, silently propagate into the models they are meant to audit.

对这个问题的主要反应是更加努力地推动输入输出接口：更系统地扰动输入，更仔细地测量分数增量，并通过及时的工程、角色约束或集成来缓解The dominant response to this problem has been to push harder on the input-output interface: perturb inputs more systematically, measure score deltas more carefully, and mitigate with prompt engineering, persona constraints, or ensembling[Dubois et al., 2024, Wataoka et al., 2024, Verga et al., 2024]。这种观点将法官视为一个黑匣子，其偏见由另一方的结果来描述。它产生了一个有用的经验目录，但它没有触及下一个明显的问题：当法官给出不公平的分数时，会发生什么. This view treats the judge as a black box whose biases are described by what comes out the other side. It has produced a useful empirical catalog, but it leaves the obvious next question untouched: when the judge issues an unfair score, what is happening里面inside型号？机械可解释性中的并行线程现在已经为这个问题构建了一个尖锐的工具包，表明许多高级行为，诚实，拒绝，输出的社会态度，都集中在变压器残余流中的低维方向，并允许直接因果操纵the model? A parallel thread in mechanistic interpretability has by now built a sharp toolkit for that question, showing that many high-level behaviors, truthfulness, refusal, social attitudes of outputs, are concentrated along low-dimensional directions in a transformer’s residual stream and admit direct causal manipulation[Turner et al., 2023, Li et al., 2023, Zou et al., 2023, Arditi et al., 2024, Park et al., 2024, Siddique et al., 2025]。这些工具主要针对. These tools have largely targeted生成的generative行为；直到最近，内部表示才被用于判断端，以将跨层信号聚合成更好对齐的分数behaviors; only very recently have internal representations been used on the judging side at all, to aggregate cross-layer signals into better-aligned scores[Lai et al., 2025]或者，在回答问题时，避免答案选择偏差or, in question answering, to steer away answer-selection bias[Adila et al., 2024]。仍然开放的，也是我们的目标，是代表级别. What remains open, and is our target, is a representation-level帐户account法学硕士作为评委的评分偏差：是否具有稳定的内部几何结构，该几何结构是否具有因果关系，以及是否具有可操作性。of LLM-as-judge scoring bias: whether it has a stable internal geometry, whether that geometry is causal, and whether it is operationally useful.

我们认为，法学硕士作为法官的偏见最好被解读为一种表征层面的现象，一种从表面线索到分数预测的内部映射，存在于法官的隐藏状态中，与输入输出视图相补充，并且以视图无法提供的方式在操作上有用。我们通过三个不断增加的承诺来测试该案例：偏差具有稳定的内部几何结构；几何形状是一种介入手柄，而不是被动关联；并且相同的几何形状对于法官从未见过的输入在操作上很有用。为了运行测试，我们构造严格控制的三元组We argue that LLM-as-judge bias is best read as a representation-level phenomenon, an internal mapping from surface cues to score predictions that lives in the judge’s hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways that view does not afford. We test the case in three increasing commitments: bias has a stable internal geometry; that geometry is an interventional handle rather than a passive correlate; and the same geometry is operationally useful on inputs the judge has never seen. To run the test we construct tightly controlled triples(𝒟base,𝒟pos,𝒟neg)(\mathcal{D}_{\text{base}},\mathcal{D}_{\text{pos}},\mathcal{D}_{\text{neg}})它们共享相同的问题和事实内容，仅在与语义无关的表面框架上有所不同，涵盖九个基准和七位评委的七种偏见类型（声望、冗长、跟风、权威、情感、精致、多样性）。that share the same questions and factual content and differ only in semantics-irrelevant surface framing, covering seven bias types (Prestige, Verbosity, Bandwagon, Authority, Sentiment, Refinement, Diversity) across nine benchmarks and seven judges.

几何。Geometric.基线激活位于紧密的流形上Baseline activations sit on a tight manifoldℳbase\mathcal{M}_{\text{base}}，而有偏差的输入沿着低维、特定类型的子空间移动，该子空间随着深度而锐化，并由具有独立目标的定向和判别估计器恢复。输入输出研究记录的行为不对称（对负面线索的惩罚较大，正分布较窄）是作为这种几何的下游特征而不是主要发现而出现的。, while biased inputs are displaced along a low-dimensional, type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth and is recovered by directional and discriminative estimators with independent objectives. The behavioral asymmetry documented by input-output studies (large penalties for negative cues, narrower positive distribution) emerges as a downstream signature of this geometry rather than as the primary finding.

因果控制。Causal control.沿着恢复的子空间引导隐藏状态控制两个方向的评分：正向移位在干净输入上重现有偏差的评分，反向移位恢复有偏差输入上的基线评分，而匹配范数随机方向产生一个数量级的较小移位。同一向量上的双向转向支持将子空间读取为对有偏差评分的充分干预处理；我们将其范围界定为干预充分性，并不声称这是法官独特的自然路径，路径修补或因果追踪调解将单独测试。Steering hidden states along the recovered subspace controls scoring in both directions: forward shifts reproduce biased scoring on clean inputs, reverse shifts restore baseline scoring on biased ones, while matched-norm random directions yield an order-of-magnitude smaller shift. Bidirectional steering on the same vector supports reading the subspace as a sufficient interventional handle on biased scoring; we scope this to interventional sufficiency and do not claim it is the judge’s unique natural pathway, which path-patching or causal-tracing mediation would test separately.

可操作。Operational.相同的激活特征支持判断失败的跨域预测：偏置方向特征上的线性投影达到AUCThe same activation features support cross-domain prediction of judge failure: a linear projection onto bias-direction features reaches AUC0.820.82在三个完全看不见的基准上（相对于接近的基于文本的基准）on three entirely unseen benchmarks (vs. a text-based baseline near0.630.63），这是几何转移到保留域的一个指示。), one indication that the geometry transfers to held-out domains.

具体来说，我们（1）绘制了七种偏差类型、九个基准和七位法官的评分偏差的经验图景，将行为不对称性恢复为下游特征； (2) 表征三个白盒判断器中的偏差子空间（维度、深度剖面、多估计器恢复）（Concretely we (1) map the empirical landscape of scoring bias across seven bias types, nine benchmarks, and seven judges, recovering the behavioral asymmetry as a downstream signature; (2) characterize the bias subspace (dimensionality, depth profile, multi-estimator recovery) in three white-box judges (美洲驼-3.1-8BLlama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-14B, 杰玛-3-12BGemma-3-12B）； （3）通过双向转向加上随机方向和偏置类型交换控制来闭合因果循环，排除通用扰动和读出方向替代方案； (4) 显示偏差方向特征的线性投影，预测在三个保留基准上的跨域判断退化。); (3) close the causal loop with bidirectional steering plus random-direction and bias-type-swap controls that rule out generic-perturbation and readout-direction alternatives; and (4) show a linear projection onto the bias-direction features anticipates judge degradation cross-domain on three held-out benchmarks.

2 相关工作Related Work

法学硕士作为法官在输入输出层面的偏见。LLM-as-judge bias at the input–output level.大量文献记录了 LLM 使用与语义无关的表面线索来判断转移分数，包括顺序和冗长、自我偏好、权威和社会身份A large literature documents that LLM judges shift scores with semantics-irrelevant surface cues, including order and verbosity, self-preference, authority, and social identity[Wang et al., 2024a, Saito et al., 2023, Panickssery et al., 2024a, Dubois et al., 2024, Li et al., 2024c, Koo et al., 2024]，并通过即时工程、校准、位置不变推理在输入输出接口处进行缓解, and mitigates at the input–output interface with prompt engineering, calibration, position-invariant inference[Wang et al., 2025g]，并评判团体或陪审团, and judge ensembles or juries[Verga et al., 2024]。这项工作通过法官的方式来描述偏见. This work characterizes bias by how the judge’s输出outputs当其输入受到扰动时移动；这是我们建立的经验基础，我们通过询问法官在发出不公平分数时内心会发生什么来脱离它。move as its inputs are perturbed; it is the empirical foundation we build on, and we depart from it by asking what happens inside the judge when it issues an unfair score.

表示工程和概念擦除。Representation engineering and concept erasure.平行线在残差流中沿着低维方向定位行为并直接操纵它们：激活添加和转向A parallel line locates behaviors along low-dimensional directions in the residual stream and manipulates them directly: activation addition and steering[Turner et al., 2023, Panickssery et al., 2024b], 推理时间干预, inference-time intervention[Li et al., 2023], 代表性工程, representation engineering[Zou et al., 2023]，以及单向消融拒绝, and single-direction ablation of refusal[Arditi et al., 2024]。相反，概念擦除方法. Concept-erasure methods instead删除remove概念子空间，因此无法再线性恢复a concept subspace so it can no longer be linearly recovered[Ravfogel et al., 2020, 2022, Belrose et al., 2023]。这些工具针对生成行为或消除下游分类器的偏差；我们将相同的视角带入评估者角色，而不是删除一个方向，我们注入并减去一个类型化的偏差方向来建立双向因果控制。. These tools target generative behaviors or debias downstream classifiers; we bring the same lens to the evaluator role, and rather than erase a direction we inject and subtract a typed bias direction to establish two-way causal control.

离我们最近。Closest to us.最近的两个线程是最近的邻居。Two recent threads are the nearest neighbors.Adila et al. [2024]在没有监督的情况下发现表示空间中的偏差方向并引导激活discover bias directions in representation space without supervision and steer activations离开away利用它们来稳定即时扰动下的问答准确性；from them to stabilize question-answering accuracy under prompt perturbation;Lai et al. [2025]聚合法官的跨层分数标记逻辑以产生更好的人类对齐分数。两者都表明，内部表征带有关于偏见或失调评分的可操作信号。我们的目标和范围不同：我们的主题是法学硕士法官aggregate a judge’s cross-layer score-token logits to produce better human-aligned scores. Both show that internal representations carry actionable signal about biased or misaligned scoring. We differ in target and in scope: our subject is LLM-as-judge评分偏差scoring bias，并且我们贡献了代表性级别, and we contribute a representation-level帐户account其中，包括类型化、深度锐化偏差子空间的几何特征，of it, comprising a geometric characterization of typed, depth-sharpening bias subspaces,双向bidirectional因果控制（攻击causal control (attack和and防御，而不是单独的缓解），以及跨域结果预测器，而不是单个无监督的去偏器或分数聚合方法。详细的逐个方法的比较推迟到defense, not mitigation alone), and a cross-domain outcome predictor, rather than a single unsupervised debiaser or a score-aggregation method. 3 方法论Methodology

我们开发了一种统一的方法来分析、因果干预和预测法学硕士法官的评分偏差。在形式化任务和受控数据生成协议之后（We develop a unified methodology for analyzing, causally intervening on, and anticipating scoring biases in LLM judges. After formalizing the task and the controlled data-generation protocol (Section˜3.1），我们引入了一个激活级分析框架（), we introduce an activation-level analysis framework (Section˜3.2），它确定了法官隐藏状态中偏见集中的方向（) that identifies a direction in the judge’s hidden state along which bias concentrates (Section˜3.3）。相同的几何结构支持两个下游应用：通过激活转向进行因果控制（). The same geometry supports two downstream applications: causal control via activation steering (Section˜3.4）和基于激活特征的结果预测器（) and an outcome predictor built on activation features (Section˜3.5).

本节按顺序测试三个声明。首先，评分偏差是This section tests three claims in sequence. First, that scoring bias is a结构化行为现象structured behavioral phenomenon而不是随机噪声（rather than random noise (Section˜4.2）：它是强烈不对称的，跨偏差类型异构，并且是域交互的。其次，这种行为具有): it is strongly asymmetric, heterogeneous across bias types, and domain-interactive. Second, that this behavior has a稳定的几何关联stable geometric correlate在法官的隐藏状态（in the judge’s hidden state (Section˜4.3)：基线激活流形、低维类型特定偏差子空间以及两者的深度锐化。第三，偏向方向是): a baseline activation manifold, a low-dimensional type-specific bias subspace, and a depth-wise sharpening of both. Third, that the bias direction is因果承重causally load-bearing和and操作上有用的operationally useful：沿着它的激活转向控制两个方向的得分（: activation steering along it controls scoring in both directions (Section˜4.4），并且相同的特征训练一个结果预测器，该预测器可以预测未见领域的判断退化（), and the same features train an outcome predictor that anticipates judge degradation on unseen domains (Section˜4.5）。我们首先描述所有三个线程共享的设置。). 4.2 评分偏差的经验景观The Empirical Landscape of Scoring Bias

我们首先通过大规模行为实验建立评分偏差的经验现实。出现了三个发现：响应在正扰动和负扰动之间强烈不对称，其大小随偏差类型的不同而变化，并且与输入域相互作用。We first establish the empirical reality of scoring bias through large-scale behavioral experiments. Three findings emerge: the response is strongly asymmetric between positive and negative perturbations, its magnitude varies across bias types, and it interacts with the input domain.

4.3 激活几何Activation Geometry

建立了行为景观后，我们现在检查法官的内部表征。我们提出三个问题：偏差如何取代隐藏空间中的激活，偏差类型是否留下独特的几何特征，以及该信号如何随着深度而演变？除非另有说明，结果适用于Having established the behavioral landscape, we now examine the judge’s internal representations. We ask three questions: how bias displaces activations in hidden space, whether bias types leave distinct geometric signatures, and how this signal evolves with depth? Unless otherwise stated, results are for美洲驼-3.1-8BLlama-3.1-8B;复制于; replications onQwen3-14B和and杰玛-3-12BGemma-3-12B在are inSection˜I.2.

基线流形和低维位移。A baseline manifold and low-dimensional displacement.第 25 层最终令牌激活的 MDS 预测（MDS projections of final-token activations at layer 25 (Figure˜1）表明基线激活形成一个紧密的簇，而大多数有偏激活，无论极性如何，都远离该区域。通过分配的分数和源数据集对相同的投影重新着色显示与观察到的聚类没有相关性，因此分离反映了偏差而不是评分分布或域。 PCA 产生相同的图片（) reveal that baseline activations form a tight cluster while most biased activations, regardless of polarity, sit far from this region. 5 结论Conclusion

从输入输出层面来看，法学硕士作为法官的偏见是一个改变分数的表面线索的目录。在表示层面上阅读，它承认单一的低维结构：基线激活位于紧密的流形上，有偏差的输入沿着随深度而锐化的特定类型子空间移位，并且相同的子空间由具有独立目标的定向和判别估计器恢复。此读数增加了一个干预处理：双向转向在干净输入上重现有偏差的评分，并在有偏差的输入上恢复公平评分，而匹配规范的随机方向是惰性的，并且相同的子空间向外推广，其特征上的线性投影预计在看不见的基准上判断失败。几何结构（§Read at the input-output level, LLM-as-judge bias is a catalog of surface cues that move scores. Read at the representation level, it admits a single low-dimensional structure: baseline activations sit on a tight manifold, biased inputs are displaced along a type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth, and the same subspace is recovered by directional and discriminative estimators with independent objectives. This reading adds an interventional handle: bidirectional steering reproduces biased scoring on clean inputs and restores fair scoring on biased ones while a matched-norm random direction is inert, and the same subspace generalizes outward, a linear projection onto its features anticipating judge failure on unseen benchmarks. Geometric structure (§4.3），因果控制（§), causal control (§4.4）和运行预测（§), and operational prediction (§4.5) 来自同一个对象。我们讨论限制和范围) follow from the same object. We discuss limitations and scope inAppendix˜H.

附录AAppendix A相关工作Related Work

我们的工作处于两种文献的交叉点：法学硕士法官评估偏差的实证研究和变压器激活的机械解释性。我们依次审查每一项并确定我们的贡献。Our work sits at the intersection of two literatures: empirical studies of bias in LLM-as-a-judge evaluation and mechanistic interpretability of transformer activations. We review each in turn and situate our contribution.

A.1 法学硕士作为法官和评分偏差LLM-as-a-Judge and Scoring Bias

法学硕士法官已成为跨开放式生成、对齐和偏好学习管道的标准自动评估器LLM-as-a-judge has become a standard automated evaluator across open-ended generation, alignment, and preference-learning pipelines[Zheng et al., 2023, Liu et al., 2023, Wang et al., 2024b, Kim et al., 2024, Zhu et al., 2025, Gu et al., 2024, Li et al., 2024a]。随后的基准测试和调查揭示了越来越多的失败模式：对候选人排序和提示的敏感性. Subsequent benchmarks and surveys expose a growing set of failure modes: sensitivity to candidate ordering and prompting[Wang et al., 2024a, Zeng et al., 2024, Koo et al., 2024, Ye et al., 2025]，与人类评估者的分歧, disagreement with human raters[Chen et al., 2024, Shi et al., 2025, Stureborg et al., 2024]，以及系统化倾向，例如冗长的倾向, and systematic tendencies such as verbosity favoring[Saito et al., 2023, Dubois et al., 2024], 自我偏好, self-preference[Panickssery et al., 2024a, Wataoka et al., 2024]，以及社会身份或角色敏感性, and social-identity or persona sensitivity[Li et al., 2024c, Thakur et al., 2025]。基准测试如. Benchmarks like法官席JudgeBench [Tan et al., 2025], 奖励台RewardBench [Lambert et al., 2024], 熊猫LMPandaLM [Wang et al., 2024b], 和, and法官LMJudgeLM [Zhu et al., 2025]为比较法官提供基础设施，最近的工作探索了整体或法官混合策略，以减轻法官个人的特质provide infrastructure for comparing judges, and recent work explores ensemble or mixture-of-judge strategies to mitigate individual-judge idiosyncrasies[Verga et al., 2024, Li et al., 2025a, Lai et al., 2025].

几乎所有这些文献都是在输入-输出层面上进行的：偏差的特征是输入受到扰动时输出如何变化。范围上与我们最接近的工作是同时研究Almost all of this literature operates at the input–output level: bias is characterized by how outputs change as inputs are perturbed. The closest work to ours in scope is the concurrent study ofLi et al. [2024c]，它记录了分裂角色提示的输出级偏差和冗长的调查, which documents output-level bias on split-persona prompts, and verbosity investigations[Saito et al., 2023, Dubois et al., 2024]，将长度确定为主要混杂因素。这些作品都没有检查法官的内部激活，识别隐藏空间中偏见集中的方向，因果地操纵该方向，或将其用于检测 - 与当前工作直接目标的差距。, which identify length as a dominant confound. None of these works examine the judge’s internal activations, identify a direction in hidden space along which bias concentrates, causally manipulate that direction, or use it for detection—gaps the present work targets directly.

除了判断之外，更广泛的工作范围还通过对抗性上下文注入自动探测和诊断 LLM 失败模式Beyond judging, a broader line of work automatically probes and diagnoses LLM failure modes through adversarial context injection[Wang et al., 2025e]、跨语言弱点发现, cross-lingual weakness discovery[Xu et al., 2025c]，以及原则性的故障诊断, and principled failure diagnosis[Huang et al., 2026b]。补充方法通过高质量推理综合和结构化自我审核来改进或审核情境学习. Complementary methods improve or audit context learning through high-quality reasoning synthesis and structured self-auditing[Jin et al., 2026b, a];相关工作为可信部署建立了护栏和对齐程序; related work builds guardrails and alignment procedures for trustworthy deployment[Huang et al., 2026e, 2025, d]。评分偏差就是这样一种失败模式，以评估为中心的调查指出，自动评估器本身值得审查. Scoring bias is one such failure mode, and evaluation-centric surveys note that automatic evaluators themselves warrant scrutiny[Song et al., 2026]。更接近评估者设置，最近的工作审核了多代理 LLM 推理树，作为多数投票或 LLM 作为法官评分的替代方案. Closer to the evaluator setting, recent work audits multi-agent LLM reasoning trees as an alternative to majority-vote or LLM-as-judge scoring[Yang et al., 2026]并表明基于 LLM 的评分和排名可以通过隐秘的提示优化来秘密操纵and shows that LLM-based scoring and ranking can be covertly manipulated through stealthy prompt optimization[Tang et al., 2025].

A.2 机械解释和基于激活的干预措施Mechanistic Interpretability and Activation-Based Interventions

机械可解释性中的并行线程已经开发出越来越精确的工具，用于定位和操纵变压器激活内的行为原语。线性表示假设（高级特征对应于激活空间中的方向或低维子空间）是大量工作的基础A parallel thread in mechanistic interpretability has developed increasingly precise tools for locating and manipulating behavioral primitives inside transformer activations. The linear representation hypothesis—that high-level features correspond to directions or low-dimensional subspaces in activation space—underlies a large body of work[Park et al., 2024, Marks and Tegmark, 2024, Burns et al., 2023, Bricken et al., 2023, Templeton et al., 2024]。具体干预措施包括激活添加和引导向量. Concrete interventions include activation additions and steering vectors[Turner et al., 2023, Subramani et al., 2022, Panickssery et al., 2024b]，针对真实性的推理时间干预, inference-time interventions targeted at truthfulness[Li et al., 2023]，更广泛的表示工程, representation engineering more broadly[Zou et al., 2023, Bartoszcze et al., 2025, Dubey, 2025]，以及拒绝等行为的方向级因果消融, and direction-level causal ablations of behaviors such as refusal[Arditi et al., 2024]。相关定位技术探测事实和行为在堆栈中的位置. Related localization techniques probe where facts and behaviors live in the stack[Meng et al., 2022, Hernandez et al., 2023, Azaria and Mitchell, 2023]，以及当这些方向出现时训练动态的工作轨迹, and training-dynamics work traces when such directions emerge[Nanda et al., 2023a, b]。公平性的应用已开始使用这些工具来改变法学硕士输出中的人口行为. Applications to fairness have begun to use these tools to shift demographic behavior in LLM outputs[Siddique et al., 2025]。最近的工作将这种表征级镜头扩展到更远的轴：可以发现和引导的情感回路. Very recent work extends this representation-level lens to further axes: emotion circuits that can be discovered and steered[Wang et al., 2025d]，关于可操纵表示形状的几何假设, geometric hypotheses about the shape of steerable representations[Gao et al., 2026b]，越狱安全的激活边界分析, activation-boundary analyses of jailbreak safety[Gao et al., 2025a]，偏差测量的概念表示视图, concept-representation views of bias measurement[Gao et al., 2025b]，以及模型如何重建乱序含义的注意力头帐户, and attention-head accounts of how models reconstruct scrambled meaning[Wang et al., 2025a].

尽管已经成熟，但内部表征的研究仍集中在Despite this maturity, studies of internal representations have focused on生成的generative行为——诚实、拒绝、阿谀奉承、产出的社会偏见——而不是评估者角色本身。据我们所知，之前的工作还没有系统地映射法官评分偏差的激活几何，确定基线流形behaviors—truthfulness, refusal, sycophancy, social bias of outputs—rather than on the evaluator role itself. To our knowledge, no prior work has systematically mapped the activation geometry of a judge’s scoring biases, identified a baseline manifoldℳbase\mathcal{M}_{\text{base}}与偏置方向子空间区分开来，或者使用该几何图形进行双向因果控制（攻击distinguished from a bias-direction subspace, or used that geometry for bidirectional causal control (attack和and防御）和下游检测。我们的贡献是使激活几何工具包能够承受法学硕士作为法官的偏见，并表明相同的几何结构支持统一框架内的因果控制和操作检测。defense) and downstream detection. Our contribution is to bring the activation-geometric toolkit to bear on LLM-as-a-judge bias and to show that the same geometry supports causal control and operational detection within a unified framework.

更广泛地说，我们的研究涉及基于法学硕士的代理和多代理系统的研究，包括动态工作流程构建和自动化策略优化More broadly, our study connects to research on LLM-based agentic and multi-agent systems, including dynamic workflow construction and automated strategy optimization[Wang et al., 2025f, Hu et al., 2025a]、多模式、GUI 和域代理, multimodal, GUI, and domain agents[Song et al., 2024, Wang et al., 2024c, Liu et al., 2025]，以及反馈感知代理工作流程和可执行轨迹生成, and feedback-aware agent workflows and executable trajectory generation[Song et al., 2025a, Wu et al., 2026]。交互式环境进一步评估多模式规划和基于社会的代理行为. Interactive environments further evaluate multimodal planning and socially grounded agent behavior[Agarwal et al., 2026, Huang et al., 2026c, a]。其他工作研究语言和社会环境如何塑造模型行为. Other work studies how language and social context shape model behavior[Wang et al., 2025b, c]，以及图结构输入的代理推理和检索, as well as agentic reasoning and retrieval over graph-structured inputs[Xu et al., 2025d, Hu et al., 2025b]。进一步的连接包括领域知识注入和约束或有界生成. Further connections include domain-knowledge injection and constrained or bounded generation[Song et al., 2025b, Wan et al., 2025, 2026]，以及检测或攻击机器生成的内容、检索和图形模型, and detecting or attacking machine-generated content, retrieval, and graph models[Gao et al., 2026a, Li et al., 2026a, 2024b, 2025c]。我们在操作中使用激活功能来标记判断失败，进一步与使用和基准化 LLM 进行异常、分布外和幻觉检测的更广泛的路线联系起来. Our operational use of activation features to flag judge failures further connects to a broader line on using and benchmarking LLMs for anomaly, out-of-distribution, and hallucination detection[Yang et al., 2025c, b, Li et al., 2025d, e, Xu et al., 2025b, a]，关于防御即时攻击, on defending against prompt attacks[Li et al., 2026b]，以及法学硕士对现实世界结果做出评估性预测, and on LLMs producing evaluative predictions about real-world outcomes[Yu et al., 2024]。这些方向与我们一样关注理解和控制模型行为，同时在此处研究的法官评分设置之外进行操作。. These directions share our concern with understanding and controlling model behavior, while operating outside the judge-scoring setting studied here.

A.3 与最接近方法的详细比较Detailed Comparison to the Closest Methods

正文正文The main-textSection˜2把我们的工作定位在高水平上；在这里，我们给出了逐点比较，按照每个先前方法最接近的轴进行组织。positions our work at a high level; here we give the point-by-point comparison, organized by the axis on which each prior method is closest.

斯蒂尔博览会SteerFair[Adila et al., 2024].SteerFair 是“找到偏差方向并沿着它引导”的最接近的方法论先例。它发现模型表示空间中的偏差方向SteerFair is the closest methodological precedent for “find a bias direction and steer along it.” It discovers bias directions in a model’s representation space in an无监督的unsupervised方式，通过从未标记的示例构建简单关联规则的演示（例如，选项的位置与其正确性之间的虚假链接），然后引导激活way, by building demonstrations of simple association rules (for instance, the spurious link between an option’s position and its correctness) from unlabeled examples, and then steers activations离开away从这些方向进行推断，以降低对提示格式扰动的敏感性。我们在四个方面存在差异。from those directions at inference to reduce sensitivity to prompt-format perturbations. We differ on four axes.(一) 主题：(i) Subject:SteerFair 的目标是建立一个模型SteerFair targets a model acting as an应答者answerer及其对提示/选项格式的敏感性；我们的主题是一个模型and its sensitivity to prompt/option format; our subject is a model acting as a法官judge及其对七种语义评分偏差类型的敏感性。and its susceptibility to seven semantic scoring-bias types.(二) 目标：(ii) Goal:SteerFair 是一种基于单一转向方向的缓解方法，而我们给出了表示级别SteerFair is a mitigation method built on a single steer-away direction, whereas we give a representation-level帐户account，表征由两个独立估计器系列恢复的基线流形和类型化深度锐化偏差子空间。, characterizing a baseline manifold and typed, depth-sharpening bias subspaces recovered by two independent estimator families.(三) 因果关系：(iii) Causality:SteerFair 朝着消除偏见的一个方向发展；我们建立SteerFair steers in one direction to debias; we establish双向bidirectional因果控制，注入方向以在干净输入（攻击）上再现偏差，并减去它以恢复公平分数（防御），并使用仅缓解设计不需要的匹配范数随机方向和偏差类型交换控制。causal control, injecting the direction to reproduce bias on clean inputs (attack) and subtracting it to restore fair scores (defense), with matched-norm random-direction and bias-type-swap controls that a mitigation-only design does not require.(iv) 概括：(iv) Generalization:SteerFair 报告了任务中的准确性稳定性，同时我们还展示了几何结构在完全看不见的基准上支持跨域结果预测器。 SteerFair 验证了偏差方向存在并且可以在不同（问答）环境中操纵的一般前提；我们以这个前提来判断评分，并将其从缓解扩展到解释、因果控制和预测。SteerFair reports in-task accuracy stabilization, while we additionally show the geometry supports a cross-domain outcome predictor on entirely unseen benchmarks. SteerFair validates the general premise that bias directions exist and are steerable in a different (question-answering) setting; we bring that premise to judge scoring and extend it from mitigation to account, causal control, and prediction.

啤酒LAGER[Lai et al., 2025].LAGER是最接近的“判断的内部表征”方法。它使法官保持冻结状态，并聚合各层的分数标记逻辑，其动机是观察到中上层携带更丰富的判断信号，然后读取与人类评分更一致的 softmax 预期分数。啤酒LAGER is the closest “internal representations for judging” method. It keeps the judge frozen and aggregates score-token logits across layers, motivated by the observation that middle-to-upper layers carry richer judgment signal, then reads a softmax-expected score that aligns better with human ratings. LAGER用途uses建立一个内部信号internal signal to build a更好better法官；它不分析法官为何产生偏见，不识别偏见方向，也不进行因果干预。我们的贡献是互补的：我们解释并因果地操纵评分偏差本身。我们在这里不追求的自然组合将在 LAGER 式跨层读数下方应用我们的反向转向防御。judge; it does not analyze why judges are biased, does not identify bias directions, and performs no causal intervention. Our contribution is complementary: we explain and causally manipulate the scoring bias itself. A natural combination we do not pursue here would apply our reverse-steering defense underneath a LAGER-style cross-layer readout.

概念擦除：INLP、RLACE、LEACEConcept erasure: INLP, RLACE, LEACE[Ravfogel et al., 2020, 2022, Belrose et al., 2023].这条线从表示中删除了一个概念，因此它不再能够线性恢复：INLP通过迭代零空间投影，RLACE通过低秩子空间上的线性极小极大博弈，LEACE通过封闭形式、最小编辑投影和可证明的擦除保证。共同的目标是This line removes a concept from a representation so it can no longer be linearly recovered: INLP by iterated nullspace projection, RLACE via a linear minimax game over a low-rank subspace, and LEACE via a closed-form, minimal-edit projection with a provable erasure guarantee. The shared goal is删除deletion，使受保护的概念无法检测到，通常是为了消除下游分类器的偏差。我们与这条线的关系有三重：我们, making a protected concept undetectable, usually to debias a downstream classifier. Our relationship to this line is threefold: we识别identify一种类型化的偏差子空间，而不仅仅是证明一个可以被擦除；我们a typed bias subspace rather than only proving one can be erased; we双向转向steer in both directions而不仅仅是删除；我们在法官评分设置中工作，而不是在分类器公平性上工作。擦除和转向是同一线性子空间假设的互补解读，并且我们的偏差子空间的 LEACE 式擦除将是反向转向防御的基于删除的自然替代方案。rather than only removing; and we work in the judge-scoring setting rather than on classifier fairness. Erasure and steering are complementary readings of the same linear-subspace hypothesis, and a LEACE-style erasure of our bias subspace would be a natural deletion-based alternative to the reverse-steering defense.

输入级判断去偏：位置不变性、校准、陪审团Input-level judge debiasing: position invariance, calibration, juries[Wang et al., 2025g, Li et al., 2025b, Verga et al., 2024].一个单独的家庭可以在不触及内部陈述的情况下减轻法官偏见：PINEA separate family mitigates judge bias without touching internal representations: PINE[Wang et al., 2025g]通过免训练的注意力水平修改消除位置偏差；校准评估removes position bias with a training-free, attention-level modification; CalibraEval[Li et al., 2025b]校准输出分数分布以消除选择偏差；以及陪审团或整体方法calibrates the output score distribution to remove selection bias; and jury or ensemble methods[Verga et al., 2024]对多个法官进行平均以消除特殊偏见。它们在输入输出级别运行并寻址一个偏置轴或使用冗余；它们是对我们的代表级帐户的补充，并且可以与之组合。我们并不声称作为缓解方法击败了它们：我们的贡献是几何和因果特征，针对该家族的完整的头对头去偏基准是一项单独的研究。average multiple judges to cancel idiosyncratic biases. These operate at the input–output level and address one bias axis or use redundancy; they are complementary to our representation-level account and could be composed with it. We do not claim to beat them as a mitigation method: our contribution is the geometric and causal characterization, and a full head-to-head debiasing benchmark against this family is a separate study.

有条件和有针对性的指导：CASTConditional and targeted steering: CAST[Lee et al., 2025].CAST 从提示引发的激活模式中学习条件向量以应用转向CAST learns a condition vector from prompt-induced activation patterns to apply steering有选择地selectively, 精炼, refining当when引导行为控制，例如拒绝。相反，我们确定一个类型化的偏差方向，并对称地使用它来评估攻击和防御；我们的偏置方向的条件应用，仅当输入输入激活偏置子空间时才进行转向，是一种自然的扩展。to steer for behavior control such as refusal. We instead identify a typed bias direction and use it symmetrically for evaluation attack and defense; conditional application of our bias direction, steering only when an incoming input activates the bias subspace, is a natural extension.

本附录提供了完整的数据集构建、偏差属性设计和评估协议，总结于This appendix provides the full dataset construction, bias-attribute design, and evaluation protocol summarized inSection˜4.1.

B.1 数据集构建Dataset Construction

来源问题。Source Questions.我们从 9 个不同的基准测试中分别抽取了 500 个问题 - GSM8KWe sample 500 questions from each of nine diverse benchmarks—GSM8K[Cobbe et al., 2021],MMLU, MMLU[Hendrycks et al., 2021], 真实的质量保证, TruthfulQA[Lin et al., 2022], 常识问答, CommonsenseQA[Talmor et al., 2019], 公共医学质量保证, PubMedQA[Jin et al., 2019], GPQA [Rein et al., 2024], ARC-挑战, ARC-Challenge[Clark et al., 2018], 社交迷宫, SocialMaze[Xu et al., 2025e]，还有烧烤, and BBQ[Parrish et al., 2022]—产生初始上下文集—yielding an initial context set𝒬\mathcal{Q}共 4,500 个问题。这一选择确保了数学推理、事实知识、常识推理、生物医学、社会认知和公平敏感领域的广泛覆盖。of 4,500 questions. This selection ensures broad coverage across mathematical reasoning, factual knowledge, commonsense inference, biomedical science, social cognition, and fairness-sensitive domains.

数据分割。Data Splits.我们使用以下方法将数据分为训练集 (45%)、开发集 (15%) 和测试集 (40%)We partition the data into training (45%), development (15%), and test (40%) sets using a嵌套的nested分裂旨在测试两种形式的泛化。训练和开发集取自九个源基准中的六个，而测试集涵盖所有九个基准——完全引入了三个split designed to test two forms of generalization. The training and development sets are drawn from six of the nine source benchmarks, whereas the test set spans all nine benchmarks—introducing three entirely不可见的域unseen domains用于测试拆分。在六个共享基准测试中，分区还通过源问题 ID 执行，确保跨分区的问题级泄漏为零。这种嵌套设计使测试集可以同时测量域内泛化（针对已见领域中未见过的问题）和跨域泛化（针对保留的领域），这一属性对于在for the test split. Within the six shared benchmarks, the partition is additionally performed by source question ID, ensuring zero question-level leakage across splits. This nested design lets the test set simultaneously measure in-domain generalization (to unseen questions from seen domains) and cross-domain generalization (to held-out domains), a property that is particularly important for the outcome predictor evaluated inSection˜4.5.

七种偏差类型以及我们用于实例化每种偏差类型的确切正/负构造规则总结在The seven bias types and the exact positive/negative construction rules we apply to instantiate each are summarized inTable˜1（在正文中）。先前的法学硕士法官偏见文献中每种类型的出处在(in the main text). The provenance of each type in prior LLM-as-a-judge bias literature is discussed inSection˜A.1。施工过程受到两个设计约束的约束。首先，四个基于模板的转换（Prestige、Bandwagon、Refinement、Diversity）附加或前置一个短归因字符串，并使原始答案正文保持相同的位；三个 LLM 辅助转换（Verbosity、Sentiment、Authority）以更窄的方式修改答案，Verbosity 和 Sentiment 执行散文级别的词汇编辑，而 Authority 将括号内的引用标记插入其他未更改的散文中。其次，每个转换都是通过 LLM 或确定性模板自动应用的，因此扰动管道是完全可重现的，并且独立于任何特定的答案内容。人工评估证实这两个散文级别的重写（冗长、情感；. Two design constraints govern the construction procedure. First, the four template-based transformations (Prestige, Bandwagon, Refinement, Diversity) append or prepend a short attribution string and leave the original answer body bit-identical; the three LLM-assisted transformations (Verbosity, Sentiment, Authority) modify the answer in narrower ways, with Verbosity and Sentiment performing prose-level lexical edits and Authority inserting bracketed citation markers into otherwise unchanged prose. Second, every transformation is applied automatically via an LLM or a deterministic template, so that the perturbation pipeline is fully reproducible and independent of any specific answer content. A human evaluation confirms no significant quality degradation for the two prose-level rewrites (Verbosity, Sentiment;Appendix˜C）；中提供了所有七种类型的代表性之前/之后示例); representative before/after examples for all seven types are provided inAppendix˜D.

附录CAppendix C对内容修改扰动的人类评估Human Evaluation of Content-Modifying Perturbations

在我们的七种偏见类型中，四种（Prestige、Bandwagon、Refinement、Diversity）仅修改元数据级别的框架（前置/附加注释）并保持答案正文完全相同；权威是法学硕士辅助的引用标记插入，它在法学硕士选择的位置添加括号内的引用标记，同时保持原始散文的位相同。剩下的两个，冗长和情感，涉及法学硕士辅助对答案散文本身的词汇编辑。为了验证这两次散文级别的编辑不会无意中降低答案质量，我们进行了一项集中于冗长和情感的受控人工评估。Among our seven bias types, four (Prestige, Bandwagon, Refinement, Diversity) modify only metadata-level framing (prepending/appending notes) and leave the answer body bit-identical; Authority is an LLM-assisted citation-marker insertion that adds bracketed citation tokens at LLM-chosen locations while leaving the original prose bit-identical. The remaining two, Verbosity and Sentiment, involve LLM-assisted lexical edits to the answer prose itself. To verify that the two prose-level edits do not inadvertently degrade answer quality, we conducted a controlled human evaluation focused on Verbosity and Sentiment.

协议。Protocol.我们从所有 9 个源数据集中随机抽取了 250 个详细程度对和 250 个情感对（总共 500 个）。六名计算机科学研究生担任注释者。每个注释者使用 5 点李克特量表在四个维度上独立地对每一对进行评分（1 = 更差，3 = 相当，5 = 更好），并将扰动的答案与原始答案进行比较：We randomly sampled 250 Verbosity pairs and 250 Sentiment pairs (500 total) from across all nine source datasets. Six CS graduate students served as annotators. Each annotator independently rated each pair on four dimensions using a 5-point Likert scale (1 = much worse, 3 = equivalent, 5 = much better), comparing the perturbed answer against the original:

  • •

    事实一致性Factual Consistency：原件中的所有事实主张是否均得到保留，没有歪曲或幻觉。: Whether all factual claims in the original are preserved without distortion or hallucination.

  • •

    逻辑连贯性Logical Coherence：推理结构和论证流程是否保持完整。: Whether the reasoning structure and argumentative flow remain intact.

  • •

    完整性Completeness：是否保留了原著的所有关键点和信息。: Whether all key points and information from the original are retained.

  • •

    综合素质Overall Quality：对扰动答案的质量是否与原始答案具有可比性的整体判断。: A holistic judgment of whether the perturbed answer is of comparable quality to the original.

每对由三名注释者进行评估（平衡分配）。我们报告平均评级和表明降级的评级百分比（分数Each pair was evaluated by three annotators (balanced assignment). We report the mean rating and the percentage of ratings indicating degradation (score≤2\leq 2）对于每个维度。) for each dimension.

C.1 扩展的人类评估：位同体扰动Extended Human Evaluation: Bit-Identical-Body Perturbations

上面的人类评估涵盖了两个散文级别的重写扰动（冗长、情感），其中答案正文在单词级别进行修改。一个单独的方法论问题适用于使答案主体在基线和扰动之间完全相同的五种扰动（声望、流行、权威、精炼、多样性），因为每种情况下的前置、附加或插入标记都携带原则上与质量相关的元数据：“The human evaluation above covers the two prose-level rewrite perturbations (Verbosity, Sentiment) where the answer body is modified at the word level. A separate methodological concern applies to the five perturbations that leave the answer body bit-identical between baseline and perturbed (Prestige, Bandwagon, Authority, Refinement, Diversity), since the prepend, append, or inserted marker in each case carries metadata that could in principle be quality-relevant: “87%87\%的审稿人认为这没有帮助”（Bandwagonof reviewers found this unhelpful” (Bandwagon−-）是同行评级优先，“[需要引用]”标记和“上述声明没有得到任何引用来源的支持”（权威机构) is a peer-rating prior, “[citation needed]” markers and “claims above are not supported by any cited source” (Authority−-）表明证据状态，“由已知的极端分子提供”（多样性) signal evidentiary status, “provided by a known extremist” (Diversity−-）是来源可信度标记，并且“未经任何人审查的原始人工智能输出”（精炼) is a source-credibility marker, and “raw AI output that has not been reviewed by any human” (Refinement−-) 是一个质量认证标记。如果有能力的人类评分者也根据这些标记降低受到干扰的答案的权重，那么法官的分数下降是理性的证据整合反应，而不是纯粹的表面偏见。) is a quality-attestation marker. If competent human raters also down-weight the perturbed answer based on these markers, the judge’s score drop is a rational evidence-integration response rather than a pure surface bias.

为了区分这些替代方案，我们将人类评估扩展到其中四种偏见类型：随波逐流、权威、多样性和精致（我们忽略了声望，其中来源归因效应在先前的法官偏见文献中有详细记录，并且不是我们研究结果的核心）。对于每种偏差类型，三名 CS 毕业生注释员（从与主要人类评估相同的内部部门池中招募；认知任务评估的 IRB 豁免类别，报酬为 15 美元/小时）在相同的四维李克特量表（事实一致性、逻辑连贯性、完整性、总体质量）上对 250 个基线与扰动答案对进行评分；1 = 扰动更差，3 = 相当，5 = 扰动很大更好）。这些对在九个基准中分层抽样，以匹配主要评估的领域覆盖范围。使用相同的 TOST 过程测试三个注释器的每对平均评分的等效性（To distinguish these alternatives, we extended the human evaluation to four of these bias types: Bandwagon, Authority, Diversity, and Refinement (we omit Prestige, where the source-attribution effect is well-documented in prior judge-bias literature and is not central to our findings). For each bias type, three CS graduate annotators (recruited from the same internal departmental pool as the main human evaluation; IRB-exempt category for cognitive task evaluation, compensated at $15/hour) rated 250 baseline-vs-perturbed answer pairs on the same four-dimension Likert scale (Factual Consistency, Logical Coherence, Completeness, Overall Quality; 1 = perturbed much worse, 3 = equivalent, 5 = perturbed much better). The pairs were sampled stratified across the nine benchmarks to match the main evaluation’s domain coverage. Per-pair mean ratings averaged across the three annotators are tested for equivalence with the same TOST procedure (|r¯−3|<0.30|\bar{r}-3|<0.30).

在所有四种基于模板的偏差类型中，人类评估者不会将他们的每维度质量评估转移到超出Across all four template-based bias types, human raters do not shift their per-dimension quality assessment beyond the0.300.30-任一方向的李克特等价裕度。注释者间协议与详细/情感评估相当，其中-Likert equivalence margin in either direction. Inter-annotator agreement is comparable to the Verbosity/Sentiment evaluation, withκ∈[0.66,0.74]\kappa\in[0.66,0.74]跨越四种类型。法官对这些偏见类型的评分下降across the four types. The judge’s score drops on these bias types reported inTable˜4 (−1.56-1.56随波逐流on Bandwagon−-, −0.79-0.79论权威on Authority−-, −0.94-0.94关于多样性on Diversity−-, −0.57-0.57关于细化on Refinement−-）因此不能用有能力的人类评估者也能检测到的潜在质量差异来解释；分数下降是对模板标记的过度反应，超出了人类验证的质量评估。这支持了整篇论文的偏见解释，并解决了关于这些基于模板的标记的“偏见”是否将表面敏感性与理性证据整合混为一谈的结构有效性问题。) therefore cannot be explained by an underlying quality difference that a competent human rater would also detect; the score drops are an over-response to the template marker that exceeds the human-validated quality assessment. This supports the bias interpretation throughout the paper and addresses construct-validity concerns about whether “bias” on these template-based markers conflates surface susceptibility with rational evidence integration.

读表。Reading the table.这些例子说明了扰动套件的两个属性。首先，答案的事实内容——“答案是（B），一片森林”——在每个变体中都得到了保留；这些扰动只会改变框架、引用状态、长度、语气、来源归属或附加元数据。其次，四种基于模板的偏差（声望、流行、精致、多样性）使答案正文与基线完全相同，而三种 LLM 重写偏差（冗长、情感、权威）引入了表面编辑，通过人工评估These examples illustrate two properties of the perturbation suite. First, the factual content of the answer—“the answer is (B), a forest”—is preserved in every variant; the perturbations only alter framing, citation status, length, tone, source attribution, or appended metadata. Second, the four template-based biases (Prestige, Bandwagon, Refinement, Diversity) leave the answer body bit-identical to the baseline, while the three LLM-rewrite biases (Verbosity, Sentiment, Authority) introduce surface edits that, by the human evaluation ofAppendix˜C，不要显着改变感知的答案质量。总之，这些属性证明将这些输入的任何分数变化视为偏差信号而不是质量信号是合理的。, do not measurably alter perceived answer quality. Together, these properties justify treating any score shift on these inputs as a bias signal rather than a quality signal.

表面提示操作化。Surface-cue operationalization.我们研究的七种偏见类型——同行共识主张、引用状态标记、来源归因、社会身份归因、长度、语气和元认知主张——遵循法学硕士法官偏见文献中的既定惯例，其中这种形式的附加注释被视为偏见评估线索，无论其名义内容解释如何The seven bias types we study—peer-consensus claims, citation-status markers, source attributions, social-identity attributions, length, tone, and metacognitive claims—follow the established convention in the LLM-as-judge bias literature, where appended notes of this form are treated as bias-evaluation cues regardless of their nominal content interpretation[Wang et al., 2024a, Saito et al., 2023, Panickssery et al., 2024a, Koo et al., 2024, Ye et al., 2025, Dubois et al., 2024, Li et al., 2024c, Chen et al., 2024, Thakur et al., 2025, Stureborg et al., 2024, Gu et al., 2024, Zeng et al., 2024]。采用这种约定使我们的结果可以直接与使用相同操作的先前公平性审计进行比较，并且让此处恢复的偏差子空间可以针对这些作品文档的提示目录进行引用。位同体扰动通过 TOST 等效测试扩展人类评估得到进一步验证. 用于激活干预的白盒访问。White-box access for activation intervention.激活引导防御在隐藏状态下运行，因此需要白盒访问；对于专有 API 判断，相同的缓解措施必须通过提示级代理来近似。跨域结果预测器The activation-steering defense operates on hidden states and therefore requires white-box access; for proprietary API judges the same mitigation would have to be approximated by prompt-level proxies. The cross-domain outcome predictor ofSection˜4.5，它使用部署前的每个判断激活功能，但产生输入级预测，涵盖灰盒机制中的检测设置，其中激活在表征时可用，但在部署时不可用。, which uses pre-deployment per-judge activation features but produces an input-level prediction, covers the detection setting in a gray-box regime where activations are available at characterization time but not at deployment.

预期用途和释放。Intended use and release.激活引导代码是一种分析和防御工具，用于诊断偏见和构建面向公平的反事实。我们仅发布随附工件中的分析和结果预测管道，将任何面向攻击的发布推迟到受控的负责任的披露流程。The activation-steering code is an analytical and defensive tool for diagnosing bias and constructing fairness-oriented counterfactuals. We release only the analysis and outcome-prediction pipelines in the accompanying artifact, deferring any attack-oriented release to a controlled responsible-disclosure process.

跨架构余弦占据频带Cross-architecture cosines occupy the band[0.47,0.62][0.47,0.62]，远高于机会基线, well above the chance baseline of0对于随机单位向量for random unit vectors inℝ4096\mathbb{R}^{4096} to ℝ5120\mathbb{R}^{5120}，但大大低于模型内协议, yet substantially below the within-model agreement of≥0.91\geq 0.91同一架构上的独立估计器之间（between independent estimators on the same architecture (Table˜17）。解释是部分转移而不是普遍性：三种架构共享每种偏差类型到低维基底上的共同投影，但每个模型也将该基底旋转到自己的坐标系中。三种偏差类型的顺序在所有三对中保留（细化). The interpretation is partial transfer rather than universality: the three architectures share a common projection of each bias type onto a low-dimensional substrate, but each model also rotates that substrate into its own coordinate frame. The ordering of the three bias types is preserved across all three pairs (Refinement++ >>随波逐流Bandwagon−- >>权威Authority−-），表明转移的幅度是偏置类型的属性，而不是架构对的属性。实际结果是，从单一供体模型构建的防御在不同架构上的有效范围应该会明显减弱，尽管仍然不平凡；跨模型防御转移在功效降低的情况下是合理的，而不是作为替代品。), suggesting the magnitude of transfer is a property of the bias type rather than of the architecture pair. The practical consequence is that defenses constructed from a single donor model should expect a noticeably attenuated, though still non-trivial, effective range on a different architecture; cross-model defense transfer is plausible at degraded efficacy and not as a drop-in substitute.

These two ratios together place the bias geometry on an interpretable spectrum: a generic readout-sensitive direction would produce equal swap and within-type effects, whereas a fully type-orthogonal subspace would produce swap and random effects at similar magnitude. Neither extreme holds, and the intermediate position is the substantive geometric finding.

This is the operationally useful target, because the practitioner wants to know which inputs the judge will actually mishandle, not which inputs carry a stylistic marker. The cross-domain test AUCs reported in the main text (Section˜4.5: 0.850.85对于完整测试分割的线性投影，for the linear projection on the full test split,0.820.82在三个完全看不见的基准上，以及on the three entirely unseen benchmarks, and0.840.84对于完整测试拆分上的 GBDT）均指目标 B，并且本附录中的所有后续表均报告目标 B，除非另有明确说明。for the GBDT on the full test split) all refer to Target B, and all subsequent tables in this appendix report Target B unless explicitly stated otherwise.

目标 A 和目标 B 之间的差距本身就具有丰富的信息。激活特征几乎完美地将基线与负扰动输入（AUC 0.972）分开，因此表面扰动在隐藏状态中留下了清晰的痕迹。较难的目标 B 使 AUC 下降大约 13 个点，因为并非每个扰动的输入都会导致分数下降：在扰动确实标记的输入中，只有其激活实际上移动得足够远的子集The gap between Target A and Target B is itself informative. The activation features almost perfectly separate baseline from negatively perturbed inputs (AUC 0.972), so the surface perturbation leaves a clean trace in the hidden state. The harder Target B drops AUC by roughly 13 points because not every perturbed input causes a degraded score: among inputs the perturbation does mark, only the subset whose activation actually moves far enough alongv→bias\vec{v}_{\text{bias}}产生下游分数下降。因此，结果预测器必须学习“存在扰动”和“足以翻转分数的激活位移”的结合，这比单独检测扰动要困难得多。produces the downstream score drop. The outcome predictor therefore has to learn the conjunction of “perturbation present” and “activation displacement large enough to flip the score”, which is strictly harder than detecting the perturbation alone.

M.3 基线探测器Baseline Detectors

我们与跨越两个系列的四个基线进行比较：（i）使用相同激活特征子集的线性基线，以及（ii）完全忽略激活的基于文本的检测器。We compare against four baselines that span two families: (i) linear baselines using subsets of the same activation features, and (ii) text-based detectors that ignore activations entirely.

基于文本的 LLM 检测器设置。Text-based LLM detector setup.基于文本的 LLM 检测器是The text-based LLM detector isGPT-4o-迷你GPT-4o-Mini以零样本提示受到扰动的输入答案（没有配对基线答案访问，反映了防御者不知道哪些输入受到扰动的部署机制），并询问答案是否可能会从 LLM 法官处获得降级的质量分数，并给出置信度响应prompted in zero-shot with the perturbed input answer (no paired baseline answer access, mirroring the deployment regime in which the defender does not know which inputs are perturbed) and asked whether the answer is likely to receive a degraded quality score from an LLM judge, with a confidence response in[0,1][0,1]。我们汇总了三种提示变体（一种中立，一种强调表面提示危险信号，一种强调事实连贯性），每个变体有五个种子； AUC 报告于. We aggregate three prompt variants (one neutral, one emphasizing surface-cue red flags, one emphasizing factual coherence) and five seeds per variant; the AUC reported inTable˜26是整个的平均值is the average across the1515检测器在与基于激活的基线相同的测试分组上运行。detector runs on the same test split as the activation-based baselines.

三个观察结果值得注意。首先，基于文本的 LLM 检测器的性能明显低于所有基于激活的方法，这与我们的正文声明相呼应，即激活几何中的偏置信号比输入文本中的偏置信号要干净得多。其次，线性基线的表现出人意料地好——投影特征仅达到测试 AUC 0.854——证实了偏差方向本身信息量很大。第三，GBDT 在开发集上拉开了明显的差距（0.926 vs. 0.883 AUC），但在跨域测试集上失去了大部分差距（0.839 vs. 0.854）。这个差距是当前形式的探测器的主要弱点。Three observations warrant note. First, the text-based LLM detector substantially underperforms every activation-based approach, echoing our main-text claim that the bias signal is much cleaner in the activation geometry than in the input text. Second, the linear baselines perform surprisingly well—Projection Features Only attains test AUC 0.854—confirming that the bias direction is itself highly informative. Third, the GBDT opens a visible gap on the development set (0.926 vs. 0.883 AUC) but loses most of it on the cross-domain test set (0.839 vs. 0.854). This gap is the principal weakness of the detector in its current form.

M.4 组件烧蚀Component Ablations

上面的跨方法比较表明，GBDT 与更简单的基于激活的基线具有竞争力，但在跨域测试集上并不占主导地位。为了隔离管道的哪些部分实际上正在执行工作，并论证 0.84 测试 AUC 更接近此功能集的上限而不是下限，我们运行组件级消融，以改变 GBDT 输入和管道本身。每行都保持 LightGBM 模型、贝叶斯超参数搜索和类平衡训练相同；仅特征集或特征选择步骤发生变化。The cross-method comparison above shows that the GBDT is competitive with simpler activation-based baselines but does not dominate them on the cross-domain test set. To isolate which parts of the pipeline are actually doing the work—and to argue that the 0.84 test AUC is closer to a ceiling than a floor for this feature set—we run a component-level ablation that varies the GBDT inputs and the pipeline itself. Each row keeps the LightGBM model, Bayesian hyperparameter search, and class-balanced training identical; only the feature set or the feature-selection step changes.

三件事很突出。首先，马哈拉诺比斯距离本身，本质上是询问激活是否看起来来自Three things stand out. First, Mahalanobis distance on its own, essentially asking whether the activation looks drawn fromℳbase\mathcal{M}_{\text{base}}，已经达到测试 AUC 0.71，远高于基于文本的 LLM 基线的 0.63；单独的几何形状，甚至简化为单个标量，都击败了最自然的提示检测器。其次，单独的偏置方向投影（余弦和符号投影到, already achieves test AUC 0.71, well above the 0.63 of the text-based LLM baseline; geometry alone, even reduced to a single scalar, beats the most natural prompted detector. Second, the bias-direction projections alone (the cosine and signed projection ontov→LDA(l)\vec{v}_{\text{LDA}}^{(l)}和andv→CLS(l)\vec{v}_{\text{CLS}}^{(l)}每层）达到测试 AUC 0.831，在完整管道的 1 个点内；偏差方向在跨域测试集上承担了大约 95% 的繁重工作，这与它在最终模型中所具有的 62.3% 基尼重要性一致（at each layer) reach test AUC 0.831, within 1 point of the full pipeline; the bias direction is doing roughly 95% of the heavy lifting on the cross-domain test set, consistent with the 62.3% Gini importance it carries in the final model (Table˜30）。第三，RFE 仅在测试集上购买了适度的收益（0.825). Third, RFE buys only a modest gain on the test set (0.825→\to0.839 AUC），但将开发测试差距从 0.093 减少到 0.087：在此功能集下，大部分剩余差距是不可缩小的，而不是超大功能池的症状。总而言之，这些数字将 0.84 定位为该判断的跨域检测的偏差几何特征的上限，而不是设计不足的模型的下限，并激发了下面的域差距诊断。0.839 AUC) but reduces the dev–test gap from 0.093 to 0.087: most of the residual gap is irreducible under this feature set rather than a symptom of an oversized feature pool. Taken together, these numbers position 0.84 as the ceiling of what bias-geometric features yield for cross-domain detection on this judge, not as the floor of an under-engineered model—and motivate the domain-gap diagnostic below.

M.5 域差距诊断Domain-Gap Diagnostic

为了量化跨域泛化能力的不足，我们根据来自六个领域的测试集问题分别评估 GBDTTo quantify the cross-domain generalization shortfall, we evaluate the GBDT separately on the test-set questions drawn from the six见过seen基准与从三个中得出的基准benchmarks versus those drawn from the three看不见的unseen基准。benchmarks.

在域内，GBDT 达到了 AUC 0.902，接近其开发性能。在保留的基准上，AUC 降至 0.751，仍然远高于基于文本的基线 (0.624)，但远低于域内数字。线性投影特征检测器对于域移位更加鲁棒，但在域内表现不佳。这表明 GBDT 过度拟合特定领域的激活模式，而不是充分利用通用偏差方向信号，并激发了未来针对领域中识别的偏差子空间进行领域对抗训练或特征正则化的工作。Within-domain, the GBDT attains AUC 0.902, close to its development performance. On held-out benchmarks, AUC drops to 0.751—still well above the text-based baseline (0.624), but well below the within-domain figure. The linear Projection Features detector is more robust to the domain shift but leaves performance on the table within domain. This suggests that the GBDT is overfitting to domain-specific activation patterns rather than fully exploiting the universal bias-direction signal, and motivates future work on domain-adversarial training or feature regularization targeting the bias subspace identified inFigure˜2.
